decisions.reason: As a close-to-core finish variant with low carrying costs, it remains a cheap option to serve continuing demand for dark bathroom designs while the firm gathers another year of evidence.

After two years, the pump-assisted line has likely revealed enough about its niche demand and support burden, and with newer pump-drain development available it is sensible to redeploy resources from this more complex option.
This tileable floor drain fits the firm’s core capabilities and barrier-free bathroom positioning so well that keeping it on the market is the clearly more likely course.
The stainless steel design grate is a complementary, low-risk extension of the existing range, so the option value of staying present still outweighs the modest cost of carrying it.

Because this newer pump-drain shower channel still has meaningful uncertainty but also strategic upside in difficult installation cases, the firm would likely keep it for another year to learn more before committing further.
